title: PixlAudio shared library render manifest (pixl.library.render v1)
description: lib/v<libV>/<videoId>/sp-<profile>.json and lib/v<libV>/<videoId>/enhanced.json in the R2 bucket (docs/handoff/2026-11-10-plans/cloud-audio-spec.md, section 3.1). The worker writes it LAST, after the audio it describes, so its presence means the render is complete; nothing in the library is ever updated in place. A phone accepts a manifest only when schema, v, libV, videoId, kind and profile are what it asked for and, after the download, the file's bytes and sha256 match. Unknown fields must be ignored.

libV.description: The library version the render was made for (1 today); the same number as in the key.

profile.description: The Spatial audio profile; null for kind enhanced.

audio.description: The file this manifest describes. null only in an enhanced.json that records that nothing was restored (so phones do not ask again).

loudness.description: null exactly when audio is null.

source.description: The song the render was made from.

itag.description: YouTube's itag of the stream the phone played, as the job said (library.source); null when it did not say.

codec.description: That stream's codec, as the job said; null when it did not say. Not the codec of the upload, which the phone may have decoded to FLAC.

decodedSamples.description: Frames per channel of the decoded upload.

cutoffHz.description: Where the song's spectrum ends: about 16000 for a band-limited stream, 20000 (an Opus stream's own edge) or the Nyquist frequency for a full one.

engine.description: The spatial renderer (pixl-spatial-1); null for kind enhanced.

stems.description: The stem separation the render was made from (open-cascade-6); null for kind enhanced and for stemMode mix.

stemMode.description: stems6: six stems. stems4: four (the fallback separator). mix: no usable stems, the stem-free render. null for kind enhanced.

applied.description: Whether the song's highs were restored before this file was made. A spatial render made from a restored song already contains the restoration.

reason.description: Why not: full_band (nothing was cut), off (the job said library.restore off), unavailable (this worker has no restoration model), failed. null when applied is true.

samples.description: Frames per channel; equals source.decodedSamples: the file keeps the source's timeline, with no added delay.

integratedLufs.description: ITU-R BS.1770 integrated loudness of the file.

sourceLufs.description: The same for the song it was made from.

headroomDb.description: How far under the source the file was levelled on purpose: 4.0 for a spatial render (integratedLufs = sourceLufs - headroomDb, within 0.3), 0 for enhanced. The app gives it back whenever its own playback gain has the room.

limiterMaxDb.description: The deepest gain reduction the true-peak limiter applied; 0 when it stayed idle.
